clips.text: Hi, I love Mom. I want to go to school today. I am happy. My teacher is nice. I like to read books with my friends. We learn new words every day. Can we play outside after school? I want to swing on the swings. I am hungry. I want a snack, please. Thank you. See you later.

clips.note: aga_bad.mp3 is the fix-burst cut to ~0.40 s and it removes the end of the word. aga_bad_light.mp3 keeps the raw through 0.90 s and only fades off the final click.
